parsed.name: RPLIDAR激光雷达
parsed.description: 一款通过串口连接的二维旋转式激光雷达，可控制电机转速并启动标准扫描或快速扫描，采集距离点数据并进行实时可视化，适用于环境感知、定位建图和障碍检测等实验。
parsed.description_en: A serial-connected 2D rotating LiDAR that can control motor speed and run standard or express scans to collect distance points with real-time visualization, suitable for experiments in environment sensing, localization and mapping, and obstacle detection.

actions.description: 连接激光雷达串口并初始化显示环境。
actions.description_en: Connect to the LiDAR serial port and initialize the display environment.

actions.description: 断开激光雷达与计算机的连接。
actions.description_en: Disconnect the LiDAR from the computer.

actions.description: 为发送给设备的命令字节串计算并附加校验和。
actions.description_en: Calculate and append a checksum to a command byte string sent to the device.

actions.description: 在可视化窗口中绘制最新扫描点、坐标轴和状态信息。
actions.description_en: Draw the latest scan points, coordinate axes, and status information in the visualization window.

actions.description: 读取并处理扫描显示界面的用户控制输入。
actions.description_en: Read and process user control inputs for the scan display interface.

actions.description: 启动标准扫描并记录采集到的点数据。
actions.description_en: Start a standard scan and record the collected point data.

actions.description: 根据原始距离和角度增量计算点坐标并加入扫描结果。
actions.description_en: Calculate point coordinates from raw distances and angular increments and add them to the scan result.

actions.description_en: Parse cabin 1 or 3 data segments from express scan data.

actions.description_en: Parse cabin 2 or 4 data segments from express scan data.

actions.description: 解析快速扫描数据中的cabin 5数据段。

actions.description: 根据原始快速扫描参数计算距离值。
actions.description_en: Calculate a distance value from raw express scan parameters.

actions.description: 根据原始快速扫描参数计算角度增量。
actions.description_en: Calculate an angular increment from raw express scan parameters.

actions.description: 启动快速扫描并解析采集到的数据。
actions.description_en: Start an express scan and parse the acquired data.
